No network access, no downloads, no encoding or obfuscation, no environment or credential harvesting, no writes outside the package's own tree, and no privilege escalation. The script does not source any external file, so nothing attacker-controlled can be injected at runtime. It could not become malicious without the referenced AppImage itself being replaced.
</details>
